name: Tanjiro Kamado
summary: After completing the Hashira Training, Tanjiro reached a level of physical ability and swordsmanship comparable to the Hashira. His Demon Slayer Mark became permanently active, effectively becoming his new base state. During the Infinity Castle battle, he fought Akaza alongside Giyu Tomioka and eventually gained access to the Transparent World and Selfless State.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

weaknesses: Demon Slayer Mark places a toll on his stamina
notes: Tanjiro's Post-Hashira Training key. His Demon Slayer Mark is permanently active and functions as his new base form. He can fight alongside Marked Giyu against Akaza and can access the Transparent World and Selfless State.
